notes.title: Version 1.0 and Future Updates!
notes.notes:
Hello dear friends, ❤️

Today, I have such wonderful news to share with you that I don't even know where to start! 🥳 I've been pouring my heart and soul into Factory Outlet Simulator for a long time, and thanks to your valuable feedback and endless support, we've taken the game to a whole new level. The game now operates with full automation, the economy system has reached a perfect balance, and our game world has become even more vibrant.

Seeing this big step as a milestone, I'm incredibly proud and delighted to announce that we are now calling our game Version 1.0. This is just the beginning, and I believe we'll achieve many more successes together.

What's new in this version:

Great News! 🎉 You can now choose which rack products are placed on during production and in the MachiStart application! By default, the warehouse rack will be selected, but if you wish, our factory restockers can place boxes on the store storage rack. This gives you complete control over logistics management.

3 new factory restockers have been added. As your business grows, your operations will run smoothly. Bigger orders, faster deliveries!

3 new store restockers have been added. While customers rapidly consume your products, we won't let your shelves stay empty. Your employees are always on duty!

Significant increase in store profitability. 💰 Now, selling in the store can earn you more than wholesale. Of course, if you land a good contract, wholesale can also be quick and profitable. The strategy is entirely in your hands!

Modern-looking new racks have been added. Seeing the same racks constantly had become a bit boring for all of us. You can make your store more attractive with new designs. And please, share your suggestions for more designs with me! (I'm not a carpenter, so I'd love to benefit from your imagination. 🙈)

New wallpapers and floorings have been added. You can now personalize your spaces even more. 🎨

Adjusted the nonsensical pricing in the customization section. Finally, you don't have to pay $75,000 for flooring! Enjoy decorating with fair and reasonable prices.

------------------------------------------------------------

Moving Forward!

Let's take a look at what we've achieved together during the early access period. We continued to enrich our game with your feedback, and here are the other fantastic features we added during this process:

Store Restocker added! 🛍️ Now, our employees place items on the shelves for us. You can sit back and watch your store grow.

Security Guards are on duty! 🚨 Catching customers who steal is no longer our job. Our security team is always vigilant to keep your store safe.

Labeling System added. You can manage the shelves as you wish and display your products in a more organized way. Control is entirely in your hands! 🏷️

Statistics Screen is now available. 📊 You can monitor your income and expenses live from the TV screen inside the factory. Financial management has never been easier.

Automation Engineer and MachiStart Application added. 🤖 You can produce the products you want with a single button without having to visit each machine individually. Save your time!

A Very Large Capacity Truck has been added to the game. 🚚 The cities might be a bit narrow, but this doesn't prevent us from preparing for intercity journeys. Big vehicles await you for your big plans.

Automatic Sales Points are now at your service. 🛒 You can load your wholesale sales onto the target vehicle with a single button. Logistics management has never been this practical.

Automatic Loading Option for the Van added. You can manage your stock and won't have to carry boxes to the van one by one. Less work, more efficiency! 🚛

Rest and Break Room Option for Our Employees added. ☕ Now, your tired employees can recover by drinking coffee or watching TV. Happy employees mean a successful business!

Train Station added. 🚂 You can now make your wholesale sales not only by road but also by rail. Time to set sail for new horizons!

In addition, we've made numerous major and minor bug fixes and optimization updates. We brought the game economy balance to the best state with your feedback. Your gaming experience will now be much smoother and more enjoyable.

------------------------------------------------------------

Looking Ahead

With this version, I will continue to develop our game at full speed, aiming to provide you with the best experience. My future plans include:

Adding new side jobs and social environments.

Creating a more lively city, making the game world more dynamic.

Developing a completely renewed art system for optimization.

Adding major features like truck journeys to different cities.

But most importantly, your creative and valuable ideas mean everything to me! 💡❤️ Together, we can make our game even more perfect with your suggestions.

Final Thanks

I sincerely thank you for the support you've given so far. We will always move forward to the best together, and being with you on this journey is a great honor for me. I love you all! ❤️

With endless love and thanks ❤️

notes.title: Factory Outlet Simulator - Patch version 0.10.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, <3

I've prepared many of the items I shared in the devlog and I'm uploading a patch over the weekend to improve your gaming experience. 

This patch includes:
-Instore product sale prices have been increased.
-Stock Exchange can now drop share values to 0. If it drops to 0, you can lose your entire portfolio :)
-Store Restockers can now place the boxes they are going to return back on the shelf they picked them up from.
-Store Restockers now have more intuitive behavior. They are more oriented to different shelves. 
-There was a lack of feedback in the Auto Sale Zone. It was reinforced with voice and text.
-Forklift reset option added (same button as Car reset)
-Fixed shoe texture bug on shelves.
-Fixed Level text growth issue.
-Smart watch prices were not showing on the shelves. Fixed.
-Storage Racks have been visually improved.

Npc stuck problem will be fixed in the next update. I found the source of the problem but I couldn't include it in this update because it will take a little longer to fix it. I postponed it to the next update in order not to keep it waiting in that process. (you can send me screenshots related to this issue via discord)

In addition, if anyone has experienced the bug of missing a product after each delivery while placing products in the vehicle with autoload, can you tell me the more detailed scenario over discord? 

Thank you very much for your support and understanding. Good games, have fun! <3

notes.title: WHOLESALE ZONE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Helloooo everyone,

As I shared in the previous update note, in this update I added the most requested automatic wholesale zone to the game. 

I will upload the car loader as soon as possible, but I wanted to at least upload the wholesale automatic sale zone as it is complete.  

If you have an active order, when you bring your vehicle to the area in the image, if the vehicle contains the box of that product, an information box will appear and it will automatically load all the boxes in the vehicle.

Of course there is a cost for this and you will have to spend a little bit of money to open each zone :)

notes.title: TRUCK UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hellooo everyone, 

I know it was very much wanted. You had a hard time fitting the panel van into the factory. 

Actually, I didn't design it to get trucks into the factory, but we are developing the game together. :)

 The level 3 factory gate is now wide enough to fit a truck inside :)

And it doesn't stop there. If it's wide enough for a truck, I added a truck to the game :) 

The price is a bit high, but our new truck with a capacity of 250 boxes has been added to the game. 

Thank you very much for your feedback and suggestions. 

I am happy to tell you the content of the next update: 
-Wholesale Restocker
-Automatic sales feature in wholesale areas

I continue to work. We develop together. <3

notes.title: Factory Outlet Simulator Update V 0.6.0
notes.notes:
Helloooo everyone, <3

I didn't come with a big update this time because I had to do some optimization and bug fixing. But I added one of the most requested things. 

Now, if you hold down the right click while looking at a shelf, you can place the product back into the box. 

(It must be the same product or the box must be empty).

-As an extra, restockers used to go to the same shelf, now they go to different shelves and this is more realistic. 

-Bugs related to raw materials in the Machistart application have been fixed. (Thank you very much for reporting.)

-In the label system, the prices of design products were not updating or showing incorrectly. Fixed.

-Minor bugs were fixed and some optimization was done. 

Keep working, I have new surprises soon :)

notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Helloooo everyone  👋 

Factory Outlet Simulator launches in early access on July 15th! 🎉 

Features that will be added to our game during this period:

-Surprise new products (it will be a real surprise!)
-Stock exchange app (you will have a lot of fun!)
-Theft and security camera (protecting your factory is a must...)
-Employees (they will make your job much easier...)
-Airport for wholesale (transportation to the whole world is now faster!)
-Trucks (we know you need a bigger truck..)
-Bank app (level design will become very difficult, and you will want to take out a loan...)
-Forklift - Machine repair - Credit cards - Invoice (essential when running a factory!)

And we are very excited to meet you with many more planned innovations! 🚀 
Let us know what features you want us to add and any feedback! 🙌

notes.title: Tomorrow is Prologue Release Day!⏰
notes.notes:

We are very excited to meet you. See you tomorrow!⏰
